introHtml: Dolman sleeve golf polo shirts offer a relaxed, modern cut that sets your team apart on the course. The extended armhole and tapered cuff provide greater range of motion for swings while maintaining a polished look. Perfect for corporate outings or tournament staff, these polos pair well with screen-printed logos or embroidered chest designs. Choose moisture-wicking fabric to keep players cool and comfortable from the first tee to the 18th green.
